commands.name: search
commands.summary: Keyword search across all Finlex data (legislation, government proposals, treaties, case law, officials). Returns hit count, category counts and hits as a Next.js server-action text stream.

commands.name: list-latest-statutes
commands.summary: List the latest statutes published in the Statute Book, as shown on the Finlex home page.

commands.name: get-statute
commands.summary: Get a statute by number and year, e.g. 55/2001 (Employment Contracts Act). Returns the title and statute text.

commands.name: get-statute-translation
commands.summary: Get the English translation page of a statute by year and number, including the translation PDF link.

commands.name: list-supreme-court-collections
commands.summary: List the Supreme Court material collections (precedents, rulings other than precedents, etc.) with last-update dates.

commands.name: list-latest-precedents
commands.summary: List the latest Supreme Court precedents (KKO).

commands.name: get-precedent
commands.summary: Get the full text of a Supreme Court precedent by year and number, e.g. KKO 2026:74.

dropped.name: download-translation-pdf
dropped.reason: Returns raw binary PDF bytes as text, which an agent can't use in JSON output. get-statute-translation now exposes the PDF URL instead.

dropped.name: list-statutes-by-year
dropped.reason: The statute list is not in the server HTML. The page renders it client-side or streams it as an RSC payload. section#content holds only the 'Statutes 2025' heading, and the only matching links are the year-navigation chips, so no static selector reliably returns the entries. The search and detail commands cover statutes.

dropped.name: list-precedents-by-year
dropped.reason: Same problem as the statutes page: the precedent list is client-rendered or streamed. section#content holds only the 'Precedents 2025' heading, and the only repeated items are menu, footer and year chips, with no precedent entries to extract. The search and get-precedent commands cover precedents.
